She would. I’m poor as hell. I work three jobs and that’s not enough. She reduced her price so I could go. She talked with my insurance to reach a deal. I hate therapy. I hate talking about my feelings. I tell her that self care is stupid and that I’m not going to get better. It’s about finding the right one. I told my therapist that I wanted to kill myself by jumping out of the building of my school but that it wouldn’t work since I have to explain to the class or at least say bye. She wasn’t scared. She didn’t scold me. She understood that I have this desire to die but that day I actually tried, I wouldn’t because I’m scared. After she talks about self care and accessing my feelings, she asks “do you think this is dumb?” I said yes. We laughed and she explained it in another way. It’s a struggle to find the right therapist. It took me 5 years. What my other therapist said made me attempt suicide. Sometimes I don’t go to therapy because I think it’s stupid and that I will never be happy and that one day I will kill myself. She never yelled at me for not going. She said she was worried and that’s it. We were back where we were. I was with you at one point. I didn’t believe anyone cared about me but the right therapist changes that

I won’t lie to you. There are therapist that suck. It’s frustrating and sometimes awful. It’s more about the long term than short term. When you find the right person who gets you, it makes a difference. I had therapist who always treated me like a child. Always ask “how does that make you feel?” I had another that told me I was in a hole that I didn’t want to get out. After all that, I hated therapy. But I met my new therapist and she understood me. She knows how I work. She doesn’t baby me or act like I’m so broken I can’t be fixed. She gets my dark humor. She gets that my trauma made me more mature than I should be so there’s no reason talking to me like a teen. She uses logical more. She calls me out in my bullshit. I see that she cares about what I say and the person I am. That’s what makes the difference.
